kickoff_prompt: You are the lead engineer for a premium AI wallpaper platform called HirecWallp (hirecwallp.com, business registered in India). Read /docs/BLUEPRINT.md and /docs/project-spec.json fully before writing code. Build ONLY Phase 1 (MVP) as defined in phases[0]. First: create CLAUDE.md summarising stack, conventions and commands; then propose the folder structure and the Supabase SQL migration, and wait for my confirmation before installing payments. Work in small commits, run lint/typecheck/tests after each step, and never put secrets in code. Treat every item under security_requirements as mandatory acceptance criteria. When Phase 1 acceptance_criteria all pass, stop and give me a checklist of what I must configure manually (API keys, webhooks, DNS).

project.name: HirecWallp
project.one_liner: Ultra-HD AI-generated wallpapers (phone, desktop, tablet) — free and paid — with country-based dynamic pricing, secure delivery, automated social marketing, and a future creator marketplace.

tech_stack.database_auth: Supabase (Postgres, Auth with email OTP + Google, Row Level Security on every table)

storage.originals: Cloudflare R2 private bucket (no public access, S3 API)
storage.previews: Cloudflare R2 public bucket behind CDN

tech_stack.image_processing: sharp (resize, visible watermark, phone/desktop mockups, preview generation)
tech_stack.forensic_watermark_worker: Python FastAPI service using invisible-watermark (dwtDct) + XMP metadata writer; called by API with a shared secret; deployable separately (Phase 2)

payments.india: Razorpay Orders + Checkout (INR, UPI first), webhook signature verification (HMAC-SHA256)
payments.international: Razorpay International card payments for credit packs (USD/GBP/EUR), same webhook verification
payments.adapter: PaymentProvider interface so Stripe / PayPal / a Merchant-of-Record can be added later without touching business logic
payments.note: Business entity is in India; Stripe is invite-only for Indian businesses, so it is NOT used in Phase 1.

ai.image_generation: provider-agnostic adapter (IMAGE_PROVIDER env); only providers whose terms allow commercial resale
ai.metadata_and_quality_review: Claude API (vision) for titles, tags, alt text, quality score

social: Instagram Graph API content publishing (Professional account)
tech_stack.scheduling: Vercel Cron for light jobs; GitHub Actions for heavy generation batches
tech_stack.testing: Vitest (unit), Playwright (critical flows: browse, free download, purchase, secure download)

security_requirements: Original full-resolution files are ONLY in the private bucket; no code path returns a permanent or public URL to them.
Public previews: max 720px long edge, JPEG quality ~70, tiled diagonal visible watermark with brand name; generated server-side at publish time.
Detail crop preview: max 600x600 region at 1:1, also watermarked.

Download flow: POST /api/download {wallpaperId, variant} → auth check → entitlement check (or is_free for free variants) → increment downloads_used atomically → issue presigned R2 URL valid 60 seconds → log row in downloads.
Max 5 downloads per entitlement (configurable); rate limit 30 downloads/hour per user and per IP hash.
Free variants require no login but are rate-limited per IP and never include the 4K+ originals.
Payment webhooks verify signatures; entitlements are created ONLY from verified webhooks, never from client redirects.
Idempotency: webhook handlers are idempotent on provider event id.
Row Level Security on all tables; users can read only their own orders, entitlements, credit_ledger, downloads.
Admin routes protected by role check on the server (middleware + RLS), not only hidden in UI.
Region pricing: display by IP geolocation, but at checkout compare with billing/card country; on mismatch use the higher-priced region.

Phase 2: per-buyer forensic watermark — first paid download of each variant is processed by the watermark worker embedding order_id, cached per entitlement; XMP metadata includes licence + order reference.
Store perceptual hash (pHash) for every asset; reject uploads that near-match existing assets (Phase 2/3).
Secrets only via env vars; add .env.example; no secrets in client bundles.
Security headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy; CSRF protection on mutating routes.

algorithm: Skip if rule.frozen or within cooldown_hours of last change or within launch_hours of launch_at (use launch_price).
demand = (paid_downloads_7d + 0.3 * free_downloads_7d) / category_median_of_same_metric (guard divide-by-zero; require >= 30 detail_views_7d before acting).
If demand > 1.5 AND conversion >= category_median_conversion → move UP one snap point (bounded by max_step_pct).
If demand < 0.5 OR conversion < 0.5 * category_median_conversion for 2 consecutive runs → move DOWN one snap point.
Clamp to [min,max]; write prices + price_history with reason and metrics jsonb.
Most specific rule wins: wallpaper > category > global.

acceptance_criteria: No original-resolution file is reachable without a valid 60-second signed URL (test by scanning HTML/network for private keys).
Paying via Razorpay test mode (INR UPI and international card) creates entitlements only after verified webhooks.
A 6th download attempt on one entitlement is refused.
Indian visitor sees ₹ prices; UK visitor sees credit costs and GBP packs; mismatched billing country is charged the higher tier.
Lighthouse performance ≥ 90 on home and detail pages (mobile).
lint, typecheck, unit and e2e tests all pass.

constraints_and_rules_for_claude_code: Build one phase at a time; do not start the next phase without explicit owner approval.
Ask before adding any paid third-party service not listed here.
Keep provider integrations behind adapters so image/upscale/payment providers can be swapped.
Never generate or accept wallpapers containing trademarked characters, brand logos, real celebrities or NSFW content; enforce in prompts and moderation.
Mark every wallpaper is_ai_generated and show an 'AI-generated' label on detail pages.
Legal page text is placeholder only — flag clearly that a lawyer/accountant must review.
Write CLAUDE.md and keep it updated with commands, structure and decisions.

Business entity is Indian: all prices stored in minor units with currency; GST-ready invoices for Indian buyers (GSTIN field on profile optional); keep tax logic configurable and flagged for CA review.
